SELECT week_ending_date, COUNT(*) AS n_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT (store_key, product_key)) AS n_distinct, COUNT(DISTINCT store_key) AS stores, SUM(closing_units) AS units, MIN(etl_loaded_at) AS min_load, MAX(etl_loaded_at) AS max_load
FROM fact_stock_week
WHERE week_ending_date >= DATE '2026-08-23'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT fiscal_period_label, period_start_date, period_end_date, weeks_in_period, fully_loaded FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year='FY2026/27' ORDER BY fiscal_period

SELECT cs.store_id, cs.store_name, COUNT(*) AS rows_, SUM(fs.closing_units) AS units, MIN(fs.closing_units) AS min_units, SUM(CASE WHEN fs.closing_units<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS neg_rows, SUM(CASE WHEN p.category='ZZ Test' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS test_rows
FROM fact_stock_week fs
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=fs.store_key
JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id=s.store_id AND cs.is_current
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=fs.product_key
WHERE fs.week_ending_date=DATE '2026-09-27'
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT cp.category, COUNT(*) AS rows_, SUM(fs.closing_units) AS units, COUNT(DISTINCT cp.sku) AS skus
FROM fact_stock_week fs
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=fs.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=fs.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE fs.week_ending_date=DATE '2026-09-27' AND s.store_id<900
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

calls.statement:
WITH params AS (
    SELECT DATE '2026-09-27' AS week_ending
),
closing AS (
    SELECT cp.category, SUM(fs.closing_units) AS closing_units
    FROM fact_stock_week fs
    JOIN dim_store s    ON s.store_key = fs.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p  ON p.product_key = fs.product_key
    JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE fs.week_ending_date = params.week_ending
      AND s.store_id < 900 AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    GROUP BY 1
),
sold AS (
    SELECT cp.category, SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold_4w, COUNT(*) AS n_lines, COUNT(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS n_distinct_lines
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s    ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p  ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN params.week_ending - 34 AND params.week_ending - 7
      AND s.store_id < 900 AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT c.category, c.closing_units, s.units_sold_4w, s.n_lines, s.n_distinct_lines,
       ROUND(s.units_sold_4w / 4.0, 1) AS avg_weekly_units_sold,
       ROUND(c.closing_units / (s.units_sold_4w / 4.0), 1) AS weeks_of_cover
FROM closing c LEFT JOIN sold s ON s.category = c.category
ORDER BY c.category

SELECT cp.category, ROUND((SELECT SUM(fs.closing_units) FROM fact_stock_week fs JOIN dim_store s2 ON s2.store_key=fs.store_key JOIN dim_product p2 ON p2.product_key=fs.product_key JOIN dim_product c2 ON c2.sku=p2.sku AND c2.is_current WHERE fs.week_ending_date=DATE '2026-09-27' AND s2.store_id<900 AND c2.category=cp.category) / (SUM(f.quantity)/4.0), 1) AS cover_incl_snapshot_week
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND s.store_id<900 AND cp.category<>'ZZ Test'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
